notes: Published peak-memory anchors for LLaMA-7B training on 24 GiB-class GPUs, as reported by the respective authors. Values are quoted as reported (unit not normalized). Protocols differ per source; see benchmarks/README.md. AdamW fp32 optimizer state alone is about 54 GB for LLaMA-7B (6.74B parameters x 8 bytes), excluding gradients and master weights, so full AdamW training does not fit on 24 GiB.
